trello.name: Sign Venue Contract
trello.desc: Ensure the venue contract is reviewed by legal and signed by the end of next week. Confirm that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms to avoid last year’s issue. Assigned to Diego.

trello.name: Confirm Speaker Lineup
trello.desc: Finalize the speaker lineup by sending follow-ups to the two maybes with a decision deadline of Friday. Use the backup list to fill any empty slots. Have the lineup locked in two weeks for agenda printing. Assigned to Bo.

trello.name: Obtain Keynote Abstract
trello.desc: Chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week as it is needed for the website and printed program. Assigned to Bo.

trello.name: Draft and Execute Email Campaign
trello.desc: Draft three email waves: agenda announcement, early-bird deadline reminder, and final-week push. The first wave should go out the day the agenda is live. Assigned to Diego.

trello.name: Update Website with Speaker Pages
trello.desc: Once the speaker lineup is locked, hand off bios and headshots to Diego for immediate landing page update. Ensure this is done the same day the lineup is locked. Assigned to Bo.

trello.name: Place Swag Order
trello.desc: Review design proofs in the shared drive and approve them. Once approved, place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers this week to ensure delivery within six weeks. Assigned to Diego and Camille.
